title: Contributor
description: Schema for a contributor registration file.

github_username.description: GitHub username. Required if the contributor participates in any GitHub-synced team.

forgejo_username.description: Forgejo/Codeberg username. Required if the contributor participates in any Forgejo-synced team.

slack_user_id.description: Slack member ID (e.g. U0123456789). Found via profile > three dots > Copy member ID.

discord_id.description: Discord user ID (numeric). Found via Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-click your name > Copy User ID.
